entities.summary: Richard Earl "Tre" Johnson III is an American professional basketball player for the Washington Wizards of the National Basketball Association (NBA). A consensus five-star recruit, he played college basketball for the Texas Longhorns and was the 2025 SEC Freshman of the Year. Johnson was selected sixth overall by the Wizards in the 2025 NBA draft.
